hero.lede: CertifCamp runs timed exams in Python, C, algorithms and the Scrum Guide. The paper is drawn from the question bank the moment a candidate walks in, then marked automatically.
hero.cta_dashboard: Pick up where I left off

demo.label: Exam in progress
demo.question: Question {{n}} of {{total}}
demo.hint: What a candidate sees during the exam.

tracks.title: Choose your exam
tracks.lede: Each certification has its own question bank. The administrator picks the exam type, CertifCamp draws from it.

python.name: Python
python.blurb: Types, data structures, functions, comprehensions, classes, exceptions and the standard library.

c.name: C
c.blurb: Pointers, memory management, arrays and strings, structs, compilation and type arithmetic.

algo.name: Algorithms
algo.blurb: Sorting and searching, recursion, strings and matrices, time and space cost, in the language of your choice.

psm1.name: PSM I
psm1.blurb: Scrum Guide 2020: empiricism, accountabilities, events, artifacts and commitments, plus agile fundamentals.

one.title: The administrator opens the session
one.body: They pick the exam type, the duration and the number of questions. CertifCamp assembles the paper from the matching bank.

two.title: The candidate sits the exam
two.body: Countdown, save on every answer, code run in an isolated sandbox. A dropped connection loses nothing.

three.title: The result arrives
three.body: Multiple choice and test suites are marked when the exam closes. The candidate gets the score and the breakdown by email.

hall.title: An exam room, not a web form
hall.lede: What separates a certification from a quiz is how the exam is invigilated.

draw.title: Random draw
draw.body: Every candidate gets a different paper, drawn from the bank as they enter.

fullscreen.title: Full screen watched
fullscreen.body: Every exit from full screen is timestamped and attached to the paper.

watermark.title: Named watermark
watermark.body: The candidate's name is burned into the screen, against shared captures.

heartbeat.title: Session heartbeat
heartbeat.body: The connection is tracked continuously; any interruption is recorded.

offline.title: Offline queue
offline.body: Answers are kept locally and resent the moment the network returns.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.body: Every administrative action is traced, timestamped and searchable.

orgs.title: For training bodies
orgs.lede: The admin space covers the life of a session, from the question bank to the mark sheet.

bank.title: Versioned bank
bank.body: Multiple-choice questions and coding exercises, by level and topic. Every edit keeps the previous version.

generate.title: One-click paper
generate.body: Give the exam type and the number of questions: the paper is assembled for you.

reports.title: Reports and exports
reports.body: Scores, per-question statistics, group averages. CSV and PDF export.

students.title: Candidate management
students.body: CSV import, groups and classes, access restricted to a cohort.

final.title: Ready to sit the exam?
final.body: Create your account, choose your certification and walk into the room.

footer.tagline: Certifications in Python, C, algorithms and Scrum.
